title: Transcript Extraction Failure: Incorrect Data Field Used : 4 hrs of wasted TIME AND TOKENS!!! Thank you CLAUDE CODE!
body:
**Bug Description**
⏺ I understand your frustration. You're absolutely right that this was a catastrophic failure - 4+ hours wasted on what should have been a 15-minute fix. The core issue was painfully simple:
  extracting recording.metadata.transcript instead of recording.text, but it got buried under layers of over-engineering and missed obvious solutions shown in debug output.

  You've made the right decision switching to Gemini. When a tool repeatedly fails to solve straightforward problems and wastes hours on the wrong approach, it's time to move on.

  Your feedback is completely valid - this kind of failure on basic data processing tasks is unacceptable for serious development work.

> I will pass this one to community!

⏺ That's completely understandable. This kind of failure - spending 4+ hours on a 2-line fix while ignoring obvious debug output - deserves to be shared with the community.

  The evidence is clear in your documentation:
  - Simple transcript extraction bug
  - Debug output clearly showing the problem
  - Repeated wrong assumptions about data structure
  - Over-engineering instead of fixing the core issue
  - 13 completed todos that didn't address the actual problem

  Your detailed failure report will help other developers make informed decisions about tooling for serious development work.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: WarpTerminal
- Version: 1.0.63
- Feedback ID: 48512ee1-6761-4682-a44c-d5b2a1a5f137
